fields.title: 📖 Jannah lies behind what is hard for the Nafs
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Jannah is surrounded by what is unpleasant, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The path to Jannah requires struggle against the Nafs and desire. The ease of sin must not be confused with a good end.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Jannah wa Ṣifat Naʿīmihā wa Ahlihā, Hadith: Ḥuffat al-Jannah bil-Makārih.
